# HK MINIJUNGLE

> HK MiniJungle Technology International Limited is a Hong Kong company developing CANVIVA living plant systems for commercial interiors. 讓自然成為空間的一部分。

## About

HK MINIJUNGLE brings living plants, spatial design, material systems and ongoing-care planning into workplaces, shopping malls and sustainability-minded brand stores. The company is based in Hong Kong and works across Nature + Art + Technology.

## CANVIVA products

### CANVIVA ONE — 單面款

A single-sided living plant system for public interiors. Site conditions, final configuration and ongoing-care responsibilities are confirmed for each project.

### CANVIVA DUO — 雙面款（即將上市 / Coming soon）

A double-sided planting concept shown through three supplied concept visualisations, not completed installations. Final design, specification, launch date and order availability are not confirmed. Names embedded in the reference artwork do not indicate collaboration, licensing or endorsement.

Final dimensions, finishes, installation interfaces, lead time, maintenance scope and commercial terms are confirmed for each project. Missing approved materials are visibly labelled on the website.

## Capabilities

- Commercial-space needs and site assessment
- CANVIVA system and planting proposals
- Installation-scope and service-access planning
- Ongoing-care responsibilities and project records
- ESG evidence support within an agreed project scope

## 中文簡介

HK MiniJungle Technology International Limited 是一家香港公司，為辦公、購物商場與可持續理念品牌店開發 CANVIVA 生命植物系統。公開選項為 CANVIVA ONE（單面款）與 CANVIVA DUO（雙面款，即將上市）。DUO 圖片為概念意向，非現貨或交付承諾。香港是目前已確認的營運基地；香港以外的交付範圍按項目另行確認。
